record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — Attendees are committed to the DB before the translation, credential and calendar-update steps, with no transaction or rollback, so a later throw returns an error while guests stay persisted; a retry then fails with emails_must_be_unique_valid and no invite emails are ever sent

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the DB write happens first via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...) before subsequent steps that can throw: building attendee translations with getTranslation (inside attendeesListPromises), fetching credentials (getUsersCredentials), and especially await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking) which is not wrapped in try/catch or a transaction. If any of those throw, the mutation errors out while the new attendees remain persisted. On a retry, the handler re-reads booking.attendees and filters guests against existing attendees, making uniqueGuests empty and throwing BAD_REQUEST with message "emails_must_be_unique_valid", matching the described broken retry behavior.
